description: Task State Machine for Firebase Analytics implementation. Sprint-based structure with dependency tracking and Context7 API references.

tasks.title: Analytics 유틸리티 파일 생성
acceptance_criteria: logEvent, logScreenView, setUserProperty 래퍼 함수가 export된다

tasks.title: SDK 초기화 코드 삽입
acceptance_criteria: app/_layout.tsx에 Firebase Analytics 초기화 코드가 삽입된다
setAnalyticsCollectionEnabled 동의 기반 활성화 로직이 포함된다

tasks.title: 스크린 트래커 및 매핑 테이블 생성
acceptance_criteria: GA_PLAN.md의 라우트-스크린 매핑 테이블이 모두 포함된다
정적 라우트와 동적 라우트 모두 처리된다

field_definitions.harness_dir: Path to the harness output directory
field_definitions.plan_last_updated: Date when GA_PLAN.md was last updated. Used for session continuity and change detection.
field_definitions.context7_checked: Whether Context7 was consulted during Planner phase
field_definitions.reference_files: List of existing project files that Generator should reference for style/patterns. Planner selects only good-pattern files to prevent bad-pattern replication.
field_definitions.sprints: Array of sprint objects grouping related tasks
field_definitions.sprints[].title: Sprint description
field_definitions.sprints[].tasks: Array of task objects within this sprint
field_definitions.tasks[].title: Short descriptive title
field_definitions.tasks[].category: Task category: setup, screen-tracking, event, user-property, consent, cleanup
field_definitions.tasks[].target_file: Primary file this task creates or modifies
field_definitions.tasks[].status: One of: fail (not yet passed), pass (verified by Evaluator), blocked (failed after max retries), existing (already implemented)
field_definitions.tasks[].acceptance_criteria: Array of strings. Each criterion must be programmatically verifiable by checking file contents, grep results, or command output.
field_definitions.tasks[].context7_apis: Array of API method names to verify via Context7 MCP
field_definitions.tasks[].plan_reference: Which section of GA_PLAN.md this task implements
field_definitions.tasks[].depends_on: Array of task IDs that must be 'pass' before this task can start
field_definitions.tasks[].evaluator_feedback: String or null. Evaluator writes specific, actionable feedback here on failure
field_definitions.tasks[].retry_count: Integer. Incremented each time Generator-Evaluator loop repeats. Max 3 before blocked.

status_transitions.fail -> pass: Only when Evaluator verifies ALL acceptance_criteria
status_transitions.fail -> blocked: After Generator-Evaluator loop repeats 3 times and still fails
status_transitions.fail -> existing: When Planner detects the task is already implemented in the codebase
status_transitions.pass -> fail: Never. Once passed, a task stays passed.
status_transitions.blocked -> fail: User intervention can unblock and reset to fail for retry
